purpose_context: This mission hardens every OpenClaw agent command against hidden dependencies on working directory, HOME/~ expansion, and which office2 checkout is active — the bug class behind #656's ModuleNotFoundError and stray-directory writes. It adds a deterministic guard (Test CI + the #587 workspace validator) so the class cannot re-enter as new agents are authored, plus converts the existing in-scope invocations to a robust, gateway-independent form. Entirely Felix-side; no native OpenClaw elements are altered.
purpose_tldr: Stop Felix agents from silently failing or writing to the wrong place due to unstated runtime-environment assumptions (cwd, HOME/~, checkout path).
